title: Embedding projected steps into extended steps
statement: For any word width $W$, extended program $P$, natural number $n$, and ordinary configurations $c,c'$, if the ordinary program obtained by projecting $P$ reaches $c'$ from $c$ in $n$ steps, then for every output bit list $o$, coin count $r$, and input and coin bit lists, the extended program $P$ takes $n$ steps from the extended configuration with state $c$, output $o$, and coin count $r$ to the one with state $c'$, output $o$, and coin count $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The projected program takes $n$ ordinary steps from $c$ to $c'$
